subject: general
question: The ancient harvest festival of Baisakhi is celebrated in which month of the year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**April**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Baisakhi,** also known as **Vaisakhi, is a historical and religious festival in Sikhism and Hinduism**.
 
• It is usually celebrated on **April 13 or 14 every year**, marking the Sikh new year.
 
• For Sikhs, it commemorates the formation of the Khalsa panth of warriors under Guru Gobind Singh Ji in 1699.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **November:** In India, several other festivals do occur in November, including **Diwali, the festival of lights, and Guru Nanak Jayanti, the birth anniversary of Guru Nanak, the founder of Sikhism.**
 
• **August:** In August, some of the notable Indian festivals include **Raksha Bandhan, which celebrates the bond between brothers and sisters, and Janmashtami, which marks the birth of Lord Krishna.**
 
• **January:** Makar Sankranti and Pongal, two major harvest festivals in India, are celebrated in this month, along with the national celebration of **Republic Day on January 26th.**
